title: SailPoint ISC Practice Leader / Senior Architect – Presales & Delivery
description:

* Full\-Time / Leadership Role

* SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC)
* SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ)
* Enterprise IAM transformations
* Presales and solution consulting
* IAM governance and architecture
* Delivery leadership

* Collaborate with global offshore and onsite teams



  





**Required Skills \& Experience:** 




**Mandatory Skills:** 



* 13\+ years of IAM experience

* Experience handling enterprise\-scale IAM programs
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Strong architecture and consulting background
* Experience working with North American customers

* LDAP

title: Presales Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Ankura Homes is dedicated to creating living spaces that support a dynamic, family\-centered lifestyle and personal growth. The company designs communities where residents can enjoy a vibrant environment, meaningful connections, and a fulfilling way of life. With a strong emphasis on innovative residential options, Ankura Homes aims to offer attractive choices for individuals and families seeking a modern, engaging lifestyle. Applicants can expect to join a team that values creativity, community, and long\-term resident well\-being.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Presales Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Hyderabad, responsible for driving pre\-sales activities that support the company’s residential offerings. This role involves engaging prospective buyers, understanding their needs, and presenting tailored housing solutions through consultations, presentations, and site visits. The Presales Manager will prepare proposals, coordinate with sales and project teams, and support integration of customer requirements into project plans. Daily responsibilities include managing lead pipelines, conducting product demonstrations, responding to inquiries, and collaborating with internal stakeholders to ensure a smooth transition from presales to sales closure. The role also requires maintaining accurate documentation, tracking metrics, and providing feedback to improve offerings and customer experience.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Candidates should possess strong Consulting and Presales skills to understand customer requirements and propose suitable solutions.
* Candidates should possess solid Sales experience, including lead management, presentations, and supporting deal closure.
* Candidates should possess Project Management capabilities to coordinate timelines, resources, and customer expectations.
* Candidates should possess Integration skills to align customer needs with Ankura Homes’ product and service offerings.
* Relevant experience in real estate, housing, or lifestyle communities is highly beneficial.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work cross\-functionally and build trust with prospective customers.
* Ability to work on\-site in Hyderabad, manage multiple opportunities simultaneously, and use CRM or similar tools for tracking presales activities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

title: Proposal Coordinator
description:
**About RADISE India Pvt Ltd** 


 RADISE India is a dynamic and exciting place to work with a focus on smart infrastructure. RADISE India is part of an ecosystem of companies — RADISE INTERNATIONAL, Smart Structures, Applied Foundation Testing, CRAIG A SMITH \& ASSOCIATES, and ETAGRA Inc — that together form the SMART INFRASTRUCTURE GROUP (SIG): a $50M organization with 350\+ employees, growing steadily. Our clients span Transportation, Waste Water, Ports, High\-Rise Buildings, Bridges, Tunnels, and Power Plants.
 




  




**About the Role** 


 RADISE India is seeking a versatile Proposal \& Market Research Coordinator to join our Hyderabad team. This role blends market/bid research with proposal coordination and writing, supporting our Engineering \& IT Staffing proposals for US Federal, SLED opportunities. The ideal candidate can identify and track bidding opportunities, maintain CRM data, and then carry those opportunities through to compliant, well\-written, and professionally packaged proposals.

 Market Research \& Bid Identification

 •      Monitor changes in advertisement dates, addenda, and award notifications; keep CRM/ERP records current and accurate.
 





 •      Conduct primary and secondary research using data collection methods such as polls, focus groups, and surveys.

title: Package Consultant-Salesforce
description:

* Develop Training Programs: Create training programs to ensure successful user adoption and long\-term usage of the implemented solutions.

 Master's Degree

 Nextrap is an analytics\-focused wearable and health technology company being built for India. Our first product combines a screenless smart band with a companion app that helps people understand sleep, recovery, activity, heart\-rate trends and the choices that shape their health.
 



 We are not looking to build just another gadget. We want to make health data genuinely useful, beautiful and actionable.
 



 The role
 



 This is not a narrow sales role and it is not a conventional marketing internship. You will be Nextrap’s first employee, working directly with the founder to help take an early wearable brand from product to real customer love, partnerships and revenue.
 



 You will speak to customers, sell the product, build early partnerships, run growth experiments, create sharp content, and bring back the honest insights that improve the product and brand.
 



 What you will own
 


* Turn early interest into sales through thoughtful outreach, product demos, follow\-ups and customer conversations.
* Build relationships with gyms, sports clubs, coaches, athletes, wellness communities, creators and relevant B2B partners.
* Represent Nextrap at events, activations and in\-person meetings.
* Run practical growth experiments across social media, WhatsApp, communities, partnerships and offline channels.
* Help shape customer\-facing messaging, sales collateral and product demos.
* Maintain a clean lead pipeline and clearly report what customers are asking for.
* Collect customer feedback and turn it into useful product and positioning insights.
* Take ownership of the work needed to move an early\-stage company forward.



 You may be a great fit if you
 


* Communicate with clarity, energy and empathy.
* Can confidently sell both a physical product and a software experience.
* Are proactive and follow through without needing every step defined.
* Care about fitness, health, technology, design or consumer brands.
* Are comfortable with rejection, ambiguity and fast iteration.
* Can write crisp messages, make a good presentation and hold an engaging product conversation.



 We would especially love to hear from people who actively
 **play sports** 
 or have competed at a high level. First\-hand experience of training, recovery and performance gives you a real advantage in understanding the product, discovering useful insights and speaking credibly with our early customers. This is a preference, not a requirement.
 



 Prior startup, consumer\-tech, fitness, sports, campus\-community, retail, sales, creator or partnership experience is useful, but not mandatory. We care more about hunger, judgment, communication and ownership than a perfect résumé.
 



**Compensation:** 

 ₹3\.0–3\.6 LPA CTC, depending on experience, demonstrated ability and fit for the role.
 




 How to apply
 



 Send your résumé and a short note answering: How would you convince a health\-conscious Indian customer to try a screenless smart band from a new brand?
 



 Also share:
 


* One example of something you have sold, grown, organised or built—at college, work or independently.
* Your sport or fitness background, if applicable, and one health or performance insight you would want a wearable to help you understand.
* One piece of honest advice you would give Nextrap as an early\-stage wearable brand.

**What Work You Will be Responsible For:**

Plan and prepare deliverable reports for review and presentation to firm and client leadership
* Perform required analysis to understand current and potential opportunities in client performance based on specific key performance indicators (ex. wRVU productivity, admissions, charge, collections, denials, AR, etc.)

**Preferred/Desired Qualifications:**

 We strongly believe in a supportive work environment where all our colleagues can succeed. EisnerAmper India is proud to be an Equal Opportunity merit\-based employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of caste \& religion, disabilities, gender, sexual orientation, age or marital status.

 The Health Care Consulting Group provides tailored services to a wide range of clients: hospitals and health systems, academic medical centers, physician and ancillary services practices, entrepreneurs and PE Firms, managed care entities and government agencies.
   

  

 EisnerAmper assists our health care clients in creating and maintaining a value\-based network, implementing positive operational improvements and building sustainable plans to meet strategic, financial and growth goals.

The team has significant experience with deal structure design, valuation, and negotiations, as well as value\-based contracting and assessing clinical programs.
   

  

**About EisnerAmper:**
 EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with nearly 5,000 employees including 450 partners across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long\-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow.

**About EisnerAmper India:**

EA India employees provide advisory services to clients of EA Group and audit services to clients of EisnerAmper LLP and comply with the professional standards applicable to each of EA India, EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP.  Hypersoft Technologies Limited is a publicly traded software products and professional IT services company, delivering financial and business applications to hundreds of customers. The organization provides consultancy services and custom software development across multiple platforms, with core strengths in client/server development, turnkey database applications, and rapid web and Windows application development. Development and support teams partner closely with clients, assuming full responsibility for delivering projects on time and to high quality standards. Hypersoft serves diverse sectors including securities management, manufacturing, ERP, business process reengineering, textiles, retail, accounting, BPO, and VoIP\-based call center solutions, and also offers packaged solutions in areas such as portfolio management, HR and payroll, medical and hospital management, and supply chain management. The company emphasizes long\-term relationships, responsiveness, and reliability, positioning itself as a trusted technology partner.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time hybrid role for a SAP CPQ Consultant based in Hyderabad, with a mix of on\-site work and some work\-from\-home flexibility. The SAP CPQ Consultant will design, configure, and maintain SAP Configure Price Quote solutions to support complex sales processes, product configuration, pricing rules, and approvals. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include gathering and analyzing business requirements, mapping them to SAP CPQ capabilities, and collaborating with sales, finance, and IT teams to optimize quoting workflows and integrations with CRM and ERP systems. The role involves creating functional and technical specifications, managing master data relevant to products and pricing, performing system testing, and supporting users through training and documentation. The consultant will also participate in continuous improvement initiatives, troubleshooting issues, and advising stakeholders on best practices for CPQ and related business processes.
   

**Qualifications**

* Knowledge of business processes related to sales, quoting, pricing, approvals, and order management, with the ability to translate them into SAP CPQ workflows.
* Experience managing master data for products, pricing, discounts, and customer information within SAP CPQ or related systems.
* Integration skills for connecting SAP CPQ with CRM, ERP, and other enterprise applications using APIs, middleware, or native connectors.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP CPQ (or similar CPQ platforms); familiarity with SAP ecosystem (SAP ERP, SAP S/4HANA, SAP CX) is an advantage.
* Proficiency in documentation, testing, and user training, with clear written and verbal communication skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field; relevant SAP or CPQ certifications are beneficial.

 Most marketplace roles eventually become coordination roles.

* Monthly GMV growth
* Contribution margin improvement

* Brand\-wise growth contribution

* Marketplace profitability

**Mindset** 



* Owner mindset with strong business thinking
* Strong bias toward numbers and outcomes
* Ability to make decisions under ambiguity
* High accountability and execution focus



  





**Experience** 




**4–7 years in:** 



* Marketplace growth
* E\-commerce business management

 Experience handling revenue ownership and marketplace scaling is essential.
 



  





**Skills** 



* Strong commercial and negotiation skills
* Understanding of marketplace ecosystems

title: Data and AI Security Consultant
description:
**Overview**
 The EAG Security Consultant \- Data Security helps enterprise customers discover, classify, protect, govern, and investigate sensitive data across Microsoft 365, Microsoft Purview, endpoints, cloud services, and AI\-enabled workflows. The role combines hands\-on Purview delivery, consulting judgment, regulatory awareness, and secure AI adoption patterns to reduce data exposure risk, strengthen DLP effectiveness, prepare customers for Copilot and agents, and create reusable EAG Security delivery IP.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead data security discovery workshops to understand sensitive data landscape, regulatory drivers, current Purview adoption, oversharing risks, and AI / Copilot readiness blockers.
* Design and implement Microsoft Purview Information Protection capabilities including sensitivity labels, label policies, encryption, auto\-labeling patterns, and user adoption controls.
* Configure, tune, and operationalize Data Loss Prevention across Microsoft 365 workloads, endpoints, cloud apps, browsers, and AI\-related workflows where applicable.
* Assess Insider Risk Management, eDiscovery, Audit, Data Lifecycle Management, and Compliance Manager usage to improve investigation readiness and governance maturity.
* Apply DSPM and data\-security\-for\-AI patterns to identify overshared sensitive data, label coverage gaps, exposed credentials, and risky data interactions before AI rollout.
* Support Data Protection Agents and Purview agent scenarios such as sensitive data discovery, SIT recommendation, DLP triage, Purview posture assessment, and regulatory mapping.
* Create executive\-ready deliverables including posture baselines, risk registers, remediation roadmaps, policy design packs, operating procedures, and adoption recommendations.
* Contribute reusable EAG Security IP, lab guides, demos, accelerators, playbooks, and enablement content for data security delivery at scale.


**Qualifications**
 Required/Minimum Qualifications
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information protection, data loss prevention, compliance engineering, data governance, or related security consulting roles.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Purview data security capabilities, especially Information Protection and Data Loss Prevention in Microsoft 365 environments.
* Working knowledge of sensitive information types, classification strategies, sensitivity labels, DLP rules, alert triage, policy tuning, and exception handling.
* Ability to translate regulatory, privacy, and business requirements into implementable Microsoft Purview controls and customer\-facing design documentation.
* Understanding of Microsoft 365 security and compliance workloads including Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, endpoints, Defender for Cloud Apps, audit and eDiscovery signals.
* Ability to analyze policy exports, telemetry, PowerShell outputs, and Purview reports to identify coverage gaps and remediation priorities.
* Strong communication skills for technical workshops, executive readouts, project governance, and cross\-functional collaboration with security, compliance, legal, and data teams.


**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience delivering Purview deployments for regulated customers across DLP, MIP, IRM, retention, eDiscovery, audit, or Copilot readiness scenarios.
* Exposure to Data Protection Agents, Purview posture assessment, custom SIT discovery, DLP triage agents, DSPM, DSPM for AI, or Security Copilot in Microsoft Purview.
* Ability to design custom sensitive information types, regex\-based detection logic, policy coverage assessments, and evidence\-backed compliance mappings.
* Familiarity with data security beyond Microsoft 365, including Azure, Fabric, Snowflake, Dataverse, SAP, Salesforce, AWS, GCP, SaaS, or file\-server governance patterns.
* Experience creating reusable consulting IP such as discovery questionnaires, policy design templates, lab guides, dashboards, scripts, reports, and executive summaries.


 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

title: Oracle Eloqua - Manager
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As an Oracle Eloqua \- Manager, you will lead the charge in optimizing operational efficiency for our clients by implementing and configuring Oracle's suite of applications. Your role will involve managing the entire customer journey, from lead generation to revenue realization, confirming seamless integration and utilization of business applications. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will focus on delivering strategic solutions that align with client objectives and enhance their business processes.
   

  

 As a Manager, you will be responsible for supervising and developing teams, managing client service accounts, and driving client engagement workstreams. You will leverage your leadership skills to inspire your team, navigate complex situations, and deliver quality outcomes. Your role will involve strategic planning, mentoring junior staff, and maintaining accountability for project success. You are expected to embrace technology and innovation, using these tools to enhance delivery and encourage others to do the same.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will have the opportunity to deepen your understanding of business contexts and develop your personal brand. You will be instrumental in building meaningful client relationships and delivering solutions that meet their strategic needs.
   

  

**Experience**
* Overall experience of 8–12 years, with strong hands\-on and leadership experience in Oracle Eloqua / Oracle Marketing Cloud and enterprise marketing automation solutions.
* Experience leading multiple end\-to\-end Oracle Eloqua implementations, enhancements, integrations, and campaign transformation initiatives.
* Strong experience in solution architecture, technical design, campaign automation, CRM integrations, delivery management, stakeholder management, and team leadership.
* Ability to lead teams comprising developers, consultants, campaign specialists, administrators, and business stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of Marketing Automation, CRM, Lead Management, Customer Journeys, Campaign Management, Analytics, Data Integration, and enterprise marketing technology ecosystems.


**Role And Responsibilities**
* Lead the overall solution design, architecture, implementation, enhancement, and support of Oracle Eloqua marketing automation solutions.
* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of marketing automation initiatives including demand\-generation programs, lead\-nurturing journeys, event campaigns, audience segmentation, email campaigns, landing pages, forms, and automated customer and prospect journeys.
* Translate business and marketing objectives into scalable and reusable Eloqua solution designs and automation strategies.
* Lead requirement\-gathering workshops and solution\-design sessions with Marketing, Business Development, CRM, Technology, Data, Analytics, and Operations teams.
* Act as a trusted advisor to business and marketing stakeholders and recommend appropriate campaign designs, segmentation strategies, personalization approaches, lead\-management processes, and marketing automation capabilities.
* Own technical and functional design decisions and ensure solutions are aligned with enterprise architecture, security, integration, data\-governance, and marketing\-technology standards.
* Review and approve technical requirements, solution designs, campaign specifications, integration mappings, testing strategies, deployment plans, and operational documentation.
* Manage multiple Eloqua projects, campaigns, and workstreams and ensure delivery within agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and business expectations.
* Identify delivery risks, dependencies, integration issues, campaign\-processing challenges, and platform limitations and drive them to resolution.
* Coordinate with Oracle Support, internal technology teams, application owners, and third\-party vendors for product issues, enhancements, patches, integrations, and technical escalations.
* Manage key business and technology stakeholders, align priorities, and ensure clear communication on scope, risks, dependencies, and delivery status.Build strong relationships across Marketing, Sales, CRM, Technology, Data, Security, Architecture, and Operations teams.
* Own the overall Oracle Eloqua solution architecture and define scalable, reusable, secure, and maintainable solution patterns.Design end\-to\-end integrations and data flows across Eloqua, CRM, CDP, middleware, analytics, and third\-party applications.
* Lead solution demonstrations, proof\-of\-concepts, and capability showcases to present Oracle Eloqua features and proposed solutions.Present architecture, campaign flows, integrations, and implementation approaches to both business and technical stakeholders.
* Support pre\-sales activities including discovery sessions, solutioning, effort estimation, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and client presentations.Work with sales and delivery teams to define suitable solution approaches, scope, timelines, assumptions, and resource requirements
* Manage resource planning, allocation, capacity, utilization, workload, and delivery commitments across multiple Eloqua projects and workstreams.Identify skill gaps, support hiring and onboarding, and drive training, cross\-skilling, mentoring, and capability development within the team.


**Oracle Eloqua Technical Responsibilities**
* Lead the design and implementation of complex Eloqua Campaign Canvas and Program Canvas solutions.
* Design and manage campaign orchestration involving segmentation, decision rules, personalization, lead nurturing, lead scoring, routing, and automated communications.
* Oversee the creation and management of:
* Email campaigns
* Landing pages
* Forms
* Progressive profiling
* Segments
* Shared filters
* Contact fields
* Custom objects
* Campaign Canvas
* Program Canvas
* Lead\-scoring models
* Campaign reporting and dashboards
* Establish reusable campaign templates, design standards, naming conventions, folder structures, and asset\-management practices.
* Define and govern audience segmentation and personalization strategies based on customer, prospect, campaign, behavioral, and CRM data.
* Lead implementation of lead\-nurturing programs and automated journeys across different stages of the customer and prospect lifecycle.
* Design and manage lead\-scoring models and lead\-management processes, including qualification, routing, and hand\-off to CRM or sales teams.
* Ensure effective synchronization of contacts, leads, campaigns, responses, opportunities, and other marketing data between Eloqua and CRM applications.
* Establish campaign quality\-assurance processes covering configuration review, end\-to\-end testing, integration testing, data validation, deployment readiness, and post\-deployment monitoring.
* Monitor campaign processing, integration jobs, CRM synchronization, and data flows and proactively resolve failed\-processing or configuration issues.
* Perform root\-cause analysis for complex campaign, data, integration, synchronization, and platform issues and recommend sustainable solutions.
* Review overall Eloqua platform usage and recommend improvements related to scalability, performance, usability, and operational efficiency.


**Integration and Data Management**
* Lead and govern integrations between Oracle Eloqua and CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Oracle Sales / Fusion CRM, and other enterprise applications.
* Strong understanding of campaign, contact, lead, opportunity, response, consent, and marketing\-preference data flows across integrated applications.
* Design and manage integrations between Eloqua and:
* Salesforce CRM
* Oracle Sales / Fusion CRM
* Event\-management platforms
* Webinar platforms
* Websites
* Analytics platforms
* Data warehouses
* Customer Data Platforms
* Third\-party marketing applications
* Experience with REST APIs, web services, SFTP/file\-based integrations, middleware, batch integrations, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Define source\-to\-target mappings and ensure appropriate data transformation, validation, synchronization, and error\-handling mechanisms.
* Promote data\-quality standards across Eloqua and connected marketing applications.
* Ensure appropriate management of customer consent, subscriptions, preferences, and marketing communication eligibility.


**Campaign Analytics and Optimization**
* Lead analysis of marketing and campaign performance, including:
* Email deliverability
* Open and click engagement
* Campaign responses
* Conversion performance
* Audience and segmentation effectiveness
* Lead\-nurturing performance
* Lead\-scoring effectiveness
* Campaign operational metrics
* Work with business and analytics teams to define campaign KPIs, dashboards, and reporting requirements.
* Translate campaign and engagement data into actionable recommendations to improve campaign effectiveness and customer engagement.
* Identify automation and optimization opportunities to reduce manual campaign activities and improve scalability.
* Evaluate new Eloqua capabilities, third\-party applications, and marketing technologies and recommend adoption based on business value.


**Platform Governance and Administration**
* Define and maintain Eloqua platform\-governance standards including:
* Naming conventions
* Folder structures
* Campaign standards
* Templates
* Asset\-management standards
* Documentation standards
* Access controls
* Environment housekeeping
* Oversee Eloqua user provisioning, role\-based access, permissions, and periodic access reviews.
* Ensure appropriate segregation of responsibilities and alignment with security and governance requirements.
* Establish Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), campaign checklists, solution documentation, reusable templates, and best\-practice frameworks.
* Drive platform\-health reviews and identify opportunities for cleanup, optimization, and standardization.
* Ensure campaign and platform processes align with applicable data privacy, consent, preference\-management, and digital\-marketing compliance requirements.


**Leadership And Management Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage a team of Associates, Senior Associates, developers, campaign specialists, and Eloqua administrators.
* Provide technical and functional guidance and act as the escalation point for complex Oracle Eloqua issues.
* Allocate work, manage priorities, monitor delivery, and ensure appropriate resource and capacity planning.
* Review team deliverables and ensure adherence to functional, technical, security, quality, and operational standards.
* Mentor team members through technical sessions, knowledge\-sharing, coaching, and hands\-on guidance.
* Provide regular performance feedback and support career and capability development within the team.
* Establish development, campaign, testing, integration, and deployment best practices across the team.
* Facilitate stakeholder meetings, requirement workshops, solution reviews, status discussions, and issue\-resolution sessions.
* Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, issues, and mitigation plans clearly to business and technology leadership.
* Build strong relationships across Marketing, Business Development, CRM, Technology, Operations, Data, Analytics, and other stakeholder groups.
* Support resource planning, project estimation, workload management, delivery forecasting, and prioritization.
* Support proposals, solution estimations, technical presentations, demonstrations, and pre\-sales activities when required.
* Identify opportunities to create reusable solutions, campaign accelerators, templates, frameworks, and automation components.
* Drive continuous improvement across Eloqua implementation, campaign delivery, platform administration, integrations, and support processes.
* Contribute to the broader Marketing Technology roadmap and recommend enhancements to platform capabilities, integrations, analytics, automation, and user adoption.


**Required Skills**
* Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle Eloqua / Oracle Marketing Cloud.
* Strong knowledge of Campaign Canvas, Program Canvas, segmentation, email campaigns, forms, landing pages, contact management, custom objects, shared filters, lead scoring, and campaign reporting.
* Strong understanding of marketing automation concepts including demand generation, campaign orchestration, lead nurturing, personalization, segmentation, lead management, and campaign analytics.
* Strong experience integrating Oracle Eloqua with Salesforce, Oracle Sales, or comparable enterprise CRM applications.
* Strong understanding of marketing and CRM data models and data movement across integrated applications.
* Experience managing complex marketing automation programs involving multiple stakeholders, technologies, integrations, and dependencies.
* Strong experience in solution design, requirements analysis, testing, deployment, production support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to perform root\-cause analysis and recommend scalable solutions.
* Experience defining and monitoring marketing KPIs, operational metrics, dashboards, and campaign\-performance reporting.
* Strong stakeholder\-management, presentation, and communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and projects in a dynamic delivery environment.
* Experience leading, mentoring, and developing technical and functional team members.


**Preferred / Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Experience with Oracle CX Sales Cloud / Oracle Fusion Sales, including REST/SOAP web services, integrations, Application Composer, Groovy scripting, and reporting.
* Experience with Salesforce CRM, particularly campaign, lead, contact, opportunity, and marketing\-integration processes.
* Knowledge of REST APIs, web services, SFTP/file\-based integrations, middleware, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience with marketing analytics, BI/reporting, and data\-visualization platforms.
* Understanding of email deliverability, subscription and preference management, consent management, data privacy, and digital\-marketing compliance.
* Experience with Agile delivery methodologies, including backlog management, sprint planning, testing, release management, and defect resolution.
* Oracle Eloqua or related Oracle Marketing / CX certifications are desirable.
* Exposure to Customer Data Platforms such as Oracle Unity and the activation of customer segments and attributes into Eloqua is an added advantage.

 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

 We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI\+ Data \+CRM. This role involves working with teams to discover, design, code and deploy Salesforce Platform solutions. 75% of this role involves programming, using Apex (Salesforce’s Java\-like language), JavaScript, and other development languages and tools.
   

  

 The ideal technical consultant is a demonstrated thought leader in technical aspects of customer and partner engagements that lead to the successful delivery of enterprise desktop, cloud, and/or mobile solutions, including enterprise integrations leveraging middleware tools and platforms. Developers deliver technical solutions to meet the customer’s business and technical requirements. Developers lead the evaluation of options and subsequent presentation and education of the customer/partner. **Description**
 The Senior Data Scientist (Strategy Data Science) is a senior individual contributor on Infor's

 **customer acquisition, opportunity prioritization, pipeline growth, and revenue generation** 
 , translating strategic business problems into rigorous, actionable analysis. This is a role for someone who combines strong analytical and technical skills with the communication ability and business judgment to create measurable business impact with data\-driven insights.
   

  

**A Typical Day In The Life Includes**
* Own data science workstreams end to end. Take business questions from initial scoping through data analysis, insight synthesis, and stakeholder communication. Manage day\-to\-day relationships with business partners. Develop exploratory insights, statistical models, and causal frameworks as appropriate.
* Frame problems before solving them. Work with stakeholders to translate business objectives into clear analytical frameworks. Influence problem framing to ensure questions can be answered using data science.
* Translate findings into decisions. Develop clear narratives and exec\-facing presentations that connect analytical results to business decisions. Prioritize actionability and connection to business outcomes without sacrificing methodological transparency.
* Collaborate across team on data foundation and DS practices. Work as part of a cohesive data science pod to share best practices, innovations and business/data knowledge.
* Support turning insights into actions. Develop production\-ready analytical scripts and contribute to collaborations with IT on deployment of insights into operational workflows.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Machine learning and statistical modeling experience. 7\+ years of experience applying machine learning, statistical modeling, predictive analytics, and data science techniques to solve complex business problems. Strong understanding of supervised learning, model evaluation, feature engineering, and statistical inference.

Experience translating emerging AI capabilities into practical business solutions.
* SaaS product, sales, or go\-to\-market analytics background. Significant experience working on customer acquisition, pipeline generation, opportunity prioritization, account scoring, or sales analytics in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment. Comfort thinking in terms of funnels, conversion metrics, account engagement, and revenue outcomes.
* End\-to\-end analytical ownership. Demonstrated ability to independently own a full analytical project, from problem framing to data acquisition and preparation, analysis, modeling, and insight communication, all with minimal technical supervision.
* Strong SQL and Python skills. Ability to independently explore and transform data, build analytical datasets, and implement statistical and machine learning models. Comfort working in Snowflake.
* Stakeholder\-facing communication. Proven ability to present analytical findings to business stakeholders in a clear, compelling, and understandable way. Experience relating methodology to business narrative and clearly identifying recommended actions for Sales, Marketing, and business leaders.
* Statistical rigor. Solid grounding in statistical methods relevant to business analytics and machine learning: regression modeling, segmentation, experimentation, propensity modeling, and predictive analytics. Ability to explain methodological choices clearly and evaluate and articulate tradeoffs between approaches.

* Sales, Marketing, or Go\-to\-Market domain experience.  Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment

Identifies and evaluates industry trends (customer industry verticals, information technology \[IT] industry). Adapts business models, plans, and solutions to insights.
   

  

 Works with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach to determine if changes are needed to the business solution. Where the cost of change is accepted by the customer, shares this feedback with the project team and the broader account team to make the necessary adjustments using mechanisms such as updating the solution approach and projected costs in presales and change requests in delivery. Contributes to Microsoft\-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.
   

  

 Uses evidence\-based approach to represent the customer/partner as a customer advocate and shares insights with Product Engineering teams and the business with a view to improving Microsoft technologies, products, services, and offerings such that they can better meet customer/partner needs across a territory.
   

  

 Architecture Design and Deployment
   

  

 Leverages a structured approach to Architecture Projects using existing methodologies (e.g., Waterfall, Agile, Iterative) that make use of existing reference architecture and established architectural styles and design patterns. Proposes and develops new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners. Builds and maintains an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to ensure the rationale for the business solution's Architecture is known and understood. 
   

  

 Defines and documents the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Leads complex cost\-based and technology\-based discussions to explain the Architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Uses a business\-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs\-savings over technical ease of execution. 
   

  

 Collaborates with the Project Manager to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots, using enterprise architecture processes and ensuring quality control through peer review. Works with customers to understand and demonstrate business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realize.
   

  

 Works with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Manages and resolves complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Maintains the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the architecture of the business solution. Drives development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer. Where there are defects, works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Customer to redress or accept and document the status of the test results. 
   

  

 Collaborates with the Account Team and/or Bid Team to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex Solution Approach with traceability of requirements, constraints, decisions, and tradeoffs that balances risk, technical credibility, and technical innovation to meet customer need, predominantly based on existing solution offerings and/or reference architecture. Jointly leads the implementation in close partnership with the Project Manager. Leads oversight and governance and establishment of quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Uses a cohesive build methodology with an agreed release schedule and timeline so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre\-sales value proposition. Works with the Project Manager to highlight where assumptions have proven false. Uses change requests to modify the Solution/project approach when needed. As needed, collaborates with subject matter experts to receive specialized advice that can help define the Solution and project approach and increase the time to value for the customer.
   

  

 Anticipates and identifies scenarios that could slow or impede pre\-sales/delivery. Orchestrates the broader Microsoft team to address technical blockers and works with account/project team to resolve non\-technical issues. Reports significant problems to Microsoft management and resolves escalations when needed. Plans a way forward in complex and ambiguous situations with an innovative approach and durable design. Delegates and leverages specialist skills of others to drive technical alignment across internal/external teams. Coordinates disparate approaches into a single plan of action for complex scenarios.  
   

  

 Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all\-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary. 
   

  

 Practice Development
   

  

 Generates new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property. Connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas to drive changes. Identifies which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers. Drives the re\-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre\-sales and delivery. Participates and contributes to internal/external communities. 
   

  

 Trusted Advisor
   

  

 Develops a network of internal/external relationships with senior\-level decision makers to build influence in addressing problems/blockers and facilitating additional views on the matter of interest. Acts as an advisor to external stakeholders. Provides direction to facilitate relationships between others. Stays up to date on Microsoft’s technologies, products, and services in order to communicate Microsoft's mission, strategy, and capabilities. When appropriate, develops a strategic relationship with key stakeholders within the customer portfolio, often as part of a steering committee, to ensure service delivery is on track and major issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed.
   

  

 Uses evidence\-based arguments that articulate complex concepts in a simple manner to respectfully challenge Microsoft and customers/partners when a decision or course of action will not produce optimal results. Leverages strategic expertise to encourage alternative approaches where applicable. Serves as the "technical conscience" to challenge the status quo and unrealistic expectations. Proactively resolves conflicts and seeks resolution to balance the overall outcome. Drives consensus where possible and leads decisions to resolve conflict when needed.
   

  

 Leads the adoption of Microsoft solutions technologies based on understanding of competitor solutions and how customer business value can be driven through Microsoft's offerings.  Thought Leadership

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC300057
description:
**Description**
**About the Role \& Team**
 We are seeking a Forward\-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high\-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI\-led engineering through hands\-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes.
   

  

 This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting\-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket\-bound Scrum cycles toward intent\-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production\-ready software.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Candidate Profile: Qualifications \& Experience**
**Must\-Have Attributes**
 Experience: 12\+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product\-side delivery.
   

  

 SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle.
   

  

 Hands\-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE\-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI\-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.
   

  

 Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases.
   

  

 Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi\-agent orchestration, AI Observability
   

  

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
 Customer\-Facing Excellence: Prior experience in high\-touch, customer\-facing technical roles (e.g., Forward\-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, Field Engineer, or Pre\-Sales Engineering Leader).
   

  

 AI Governance \& Security: A strong grasp of AI governance models, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, responsible AI frameworks, observability, and production readiness for AI\-enabled enterprise systems.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Client Engagement \& Strategic Architecture


 Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high\-value areas for AI\-led acceleration.
   

  

 Design \& Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands\-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.
   

  

 Lead the Intent\-Driven Transition: Guide clients away from rigid, manual sprint mechanics toward fluid, intent\-driven delivery loops capable of autonomously generating plans, code, tests, documentation, and validation artifacts.
   

  

  

* Value Measurement \& Executive Alignment


 Quantify AI Impact: Define, measure, and report on hard engineering acceleration outcomes, including reduced cycle times, faster story\-to\-code conversion, improved automated testing, and accelerated code reviews.
   

  

 Technical \& Executive Presentation: Communicate complex technical approaches, agentic architectures, proof results, and long\-term adoption strategies to both engineering teams and C\-level stakeholders.

 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.

title: Consulting Practice Leader
description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world\-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting\-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment**
* Gathers customer/partner insights from a broad range of stakeholders as well as the main business sponsor to shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of projects. Identifies and evaluates industry trends (customer industry verticals, information technology \[IT] industry). Adapts business models, plans, and solutions to insights.
* Works with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach to determine if changes are needed to the business solution. Where the cost of change is accepted by the customer, shares this feedback with the project team and the broader account team to make the necessary adjustments using mechanisms such as updating the solution approach and projected costs in presales and change requests in delivery. Contributes to Microsoft\-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.
* Uses evidence\-based approach to represent the customer/partner as a customer advocate and shares insights with Product Engineering teams and the business with a view to improving Microsoft technologies, products, services, and offerings such that they can better meet customer/partner needs across a territory.


**Architecture Design and Deployment**
* Leverages a structured approach to Architecture Projects using existing methodologies (e.g., Waterfall, Agile, Iterative) that make use of existing reference architecture and established architectural styles and design patterns. Proposes and develops new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners. Builds and maintains an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to ensure the rationale for the business solution's Architecture is known and understood.
* Defines and documents the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Leads complex cost\-based and technology\-based discussions to explain the Architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Uses a business\-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs\-savings over technical ease of execution.
* Collaborates with the Project Manager to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots, using enterprise architecture processes and ensuring quality control through peer review. Works with customers to understand and demonstrate business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realize.
* Works with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Manages and resolves complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Maintains the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the architecture of the business solution. Drives development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer. Where there are defects, works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Customer to redress or accept and document the status of the test results.
* Collaborates with the Account Team and/or Bid Team to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex Solution Approach with traceability of requirements, constraints, decisions, and tradeoffs that balances risk, technical credibility, and technical innovation to meet customer need, predominantly based on existing solution offerings and/or reference architecture. Jointly leads the implementation in close partnership with the Project Manager. Leads oversight and governance and establishment of quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Uses a cohesive build methodology with an agreed release schedule and timeline so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre\-sales value proposition. Works with the Project Manager to highlight where assumptions have proven false. Uses change requests to modify the Solution/project approach when needed. As needed, collaborates with subject matter experts to receive specialized advice that can help define the Solution and project approach and increase the time to value for the customer.
* Anticipates and identifies scenarios that could slow or impede pre\-sales/delivery. Orchestrates the broader Microsoft team to address technical blockers and works with account/project team to resolve non\-technical issues. Reports significant problems to Microsoft management and resolves escalations when needed. Plans a way forward in complex and ambiguous situations with an innovative approach and durable design. Delegates and leverages specialist skills of others to drive technical alignment across internal/external teams. Coordinates disparate approaches into a single plan of action for complex scenarios.
* Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all\-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary.


**Practice Development**
* Generates new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property. Connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas to drive changes. Identifies which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers. Drives the re\-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre\-sales and delivery. Participates and contributes to internal/external communities.


**Trusted Advisor**
* Develops a network of internal/external relationships with senior\-level decision makers to build influence in addressing problems/blockers and facilitating additional views on the matter of interest. Acts as an advisor to external stakeholders. Provides direction to facilitate relationships between others. Stays up to date on Microsoft’s technologies, products, and services in order to communicate Microsoft's mission, strategy, and capabilities. When appropriate, develops a strategic relationship with key stakeholders within the customer portfolio, often as part of a steering committee, to ensure service delivery is on track and major issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed.
* Uses evidence\-based arguments that articulate complex concepts in a simple manner to respectfully challenge Microsoft and customers/partners when a decision or course of action will not produce optimal results. Leverages strategic expertise to encourage alternative approaches where applicable. Serves as the "technical conscience" to challenge the status quo and unrealistic expectations. Proactively resolves conflicts and seeks resolution to balance the overall outcome. Drives consensus where possible and leads decisions to resolve conflict when needed.
* Leads the adoption of Microsoft solutions technologies based on understanding of competitor solutions and how customer business value can be driven through Microsoft's offerings. Differentiates Microsoft's solutions in customer/partner conversations to influence the industry\-wide direction for specific architecture(s).


**Thought Leadership**
* Leads virtual teams around technologies and customer/partner challenges by sharing ideas, insight, and strategic, technical input with technical teams, internal communities across the field, and the larger virtual team across Microsoft using knowledge of Microsoft architectures and their context in the competitive landscape.
* Participates in external architect community events (e.g., conferences, seminars, technical meetups, Webcasts, blogs, hackathons) and shares learnings with internal team. Acts a mentor to less experienced colleagues by educating them on technical and non\-technical concepts and sharing best practices. Demonstrates deep industry knowledge and drives recognition for Microsoft solutions through presentations and engagements with external audiences.


**Other**
* Embody our culture and values


**Qualifications**
**Required/Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 8\+ years' experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)
+ OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 6\+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)
+ OR equivalent experience.

* 2\+ years managing multiple projects or portfolios.
* 1\+ year(s) experience leading blended, multidisciplinary teams.


**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 12\+ years' experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)
+ OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 8\+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)
+ OR equivalent experience.

* 6\+ years technical sales experience.
* 6\+ years project management experience.
* 3\+ years people management experience, including managing consultant practice managers, technical sales managers, and/or technical architect managers.
* Technical or Professional Certification in Domain (e.g., Security).

**Job Description**
**JOB DATA**
 JOB TITLE: Senior Consultant
   

  

**About Intangent**
 We are North America's fastest growing Sales Performance Management consultancy. We've grown rapidly by working with the best and brightest in our industry. Our high performing consulting team and market\-leading vendor partners reflect Intangent's unwavering focus on best execution in customer experience.  Visit us at https://intangent.com/
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking an experienced
 **Xactly Consultant** 
 with a strong focus on
 **Xactly Incent** 
 and
 **Xactly Analytics** 
 to join our team. The successful candidate will lead the implementation, configuration, and optimization of Xactly solutions, providing clients with cutting\-edge tools to manage their incentive compensation programs and gain data\-driven insights. This role requires deep technical expertise in Xactly’s Incentive Compensation and Analytics platforms, alongside a solid understanding of Sales Performance Management (SPM) frameworks.
   

  

**Desired Skills And Experience**
**Xactly Incent Implementation \& Configuration** 
 :
   

  

* Lead the end\-to\-end configuration and implementation of Xactly Incent, including designing compensation plans, setting up quotas, crediting rules, and calculating commission payouts.
* Customize Compensation Rules to reflect complex commission structures, such as tiered payouts, accelerators, draws, and recoveries, based on client\-specific business requirements.
* Configure and manage participant hierarchies, team structures, and territory assignments, ensuring accurate compensation tracking.
* Create and maintain calculation formulas, including base pay, bonuses, and multi\-variable commissions, using Xactly’s Calculation Engine.
* Handle the credit assignment process, including splitting credits between multiple participants or roles and ensuring accurate credit allocation to sales activities.
* Configure and manage Plan Documents and Participant Statements, ensuring transparency and clarity in commission reporting.
* Perform data loading and integration of various input sources (e.g., CRM data from Salesforce, ERP systems, or manual files) using Xactly's Connect integration tool.
* Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate the functionality of the system and ensure the accuracy of calculations.
* Set up and manage dispute workflows, providing users with mechanisms to contest commissions and ensuring proper audit trails.


**Xactly Analytics And Reporting**
* Develop and configure Xactly Analytics dashboards and custom reports to provide clients with real\-time visibility into performance metrics, incentive payouts, and sales effectiveness.
* Build advanced reporting frameworks to track critical metrics, such as quota attainment, sales by product, compensation by territory, and team performance.
* Utilize Xactly Analytics' data visualization tools to design and present intuitive charts and graphs that highlight key insights for executives and sales leaders.
* Configure custom calculation logic for reporting purposes, including aggregate functions like year\-over\-year comparisons, trend analysis, and commission forecasting.
* Implement role\-based security in Xactly Analytics to ensure proper data access controls, enabling different levels of visibility for stakeholders (e.g., sales reps, managers, and executives).


**Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of experience in a software development or systems analyst role
* Must be comfortable with emerging technologies, learning new software, understanding a data model and an object model, writing SQL queries, and writing design specifications
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* 3\-5 years of experience implementing Xactly Incent and Xactly Analytics.


**Technical \& Business Requirements**
* Knowledge of software development \& implementation life cycles
* Experience with major relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server, etc.)
* Proficient in Xactly Incent configuration, including:
+ Compensation Plan Design: Structuring and configuring incentive compensation plans, defining quotas, crediting rules, and payout methods.
+ Participant Management: Setting up and managing user hierarchies, teams, roles, and permissions.
+ Calculation Engine: Building custom formulas, handling complex calculation rules (e.g., weighted commissions, bonuses).
+ Plan Document Automation: Configuring automated and customizable participant statements and documents.
+ Quota Management: Configuring and managing quota\-setting processes.

* Expertise in Xactly Analytics configuration and reporting:
+ Advanced Data Modeling: Designing and configuring custom reports and dashboards.
+ Complex Report Building: Developing performance dashboards that aggregate sales data and compensation metrics.


**Knowledge Of The Following Technologies Is Considered An Asset**
* Microsoft SQL Server, Informatica, Xactly, Varicent
* Web technologies such as JavaScript, XML, CSS, and HTML
* BI Cognos reporting


 SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS)

title: Senior Analyst - Strategy Specialist
description:
**About DESRI**
 DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market\-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 13 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 85 renewable energy projects in 24 states. DESRI is run by a dynamic team with offices located at New York, Denver, and Hyderabad (India).
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an Analyst / Senior Analyst to join our Hyderabad office as part of the Strategy team. The Strategy team focuses on project acquisitions, PPA origination, market and corporate strategy, and capital raising. The team works closely across DESRI business units — including Finance, Development, EPC, Procurement, Legal, and FP\&A — to price risk and execute new opportunities that drive long\-term NAV growth. The candidate will be a part of an inclusive, highly skilled team responsible for supporting DESRI’s portfolio of wind, solar, and storage projects within a dynamic environment that values collaboration, thoughtful problem solving, and attention to detail.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Bid modeling and valuation for project acquisitions, PPA/ESA origination, repowers, and surplus BESS opportunities at any stage of the project life cycle.
* Assist in pricing and structuring bids targeting pre\-tax IRR and minimum NAV thresholds.
* Coordinate with EPC, Procurement, and Legal to validate assumptions and optimize site.
* Diligence support coordinating with DESRI Development \& EPC to evaluate project risk profiles.
* Conduct research on U.S. renewable markets covering financing markets, equipment pricing, competitor analysis, new markets, interconnection positions, and new technology
* synthesizing insights from public sources, utility proceedings, and internal databases.
* Contribute to battery strategy analysis, competitive intelligence, and management reporting on key market indicators.
* Prepare investor presentations, marketing materials, and support offtake diligence.


**Qualifications**
* Candidates holding MBA or relevant degree with 2–4 years of experience in investment banking, project finance, Strategy or consulting domain
* Strong financial modeling skills in Excel; ability to synthesize complex information into clear conclusions.
* Familiarity with renewable energy markets, PPA structures, and energy storage is preferred.
* Demonstrated intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and strong written and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams across teams in different time zones.
* Strong familiarity with usage of various AI models to optimize financial models, research and development and due diligence

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**Company Description**
 Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About us, but we'll be brief:**
 Experian is the world's leading global information services company, unlocking the power of data to create more opportunities for consumers, businesses and society. We are thrilled to share that FORTUNE has named Experian one of the 100 Best Companies to work for. In addition, for the last five years we've been listed as one of the 100 "World's Most Innovative Companies" by Forbes Magazine.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 You will be the architecture owner for Experian's telephony, Teams Calling, and Contact Center services. As we modernize, we are moving toward a cloud‑first, Teams‑centric model. In this model, NICE will serve as the contact center platform, and we will use Teams Calling for corporate/campus telephony. This role is accountable for the end‑to‑end technical design and standards. This includes global telephony transformation. We mean this transformation to replace EOL Avaya, reduce on\-premise dependencies. It will also deliver features such as advanced IVR, dashboards, reporting, AI/speech recognition, omnichannel, call recording, and call accounting, etc. Additionally, I designed and guided Experian's contact center capability uplift. This included Presence Bi‑Sync with Salesforce Omni‑Channel, advanced quality, sentiment analysis, self‑service/automation, and ACD enhancements. I measured all of these against efficiency targets and business benefits. APAC modernization and discovery work (e.g., Teams Calling \+ NICE CXone direction; addressing EOL Cisco/Ribbon, India calling enablement constraints, and staff augmentation needs). This role directly owns PSTN/calling architecture, carrier/SBC design, numbering/porting, call routing, contact center flows, recording/QA/analytics, and compliance\-aligned controls. You will report to a Senior Director.
   

  

**Summary Of Primary Responsibilities**
* Own global telephony \& contact center target architectures: Define and maintain end‑to‑end designs for Teams Calling, NICE contact center, call routing, numbering, porting, recording/CDR, and integration patterns across regions.
* The UKI \& EMEA telephony modernization architecture authority is responsible for leading the technical approach. This approach involves replacing legacy Avaya, including the decommission of \~60 Avaya devices, and delivering the proposed campus/contact center changes. These changes include desk phone removal as standard, power\-user and VIP retention models, mandatory CC training, and enhanced IVR/ACD/analytics/automation capabilities.
* Contact center evolution and feature enablement involve architecting and governing advanced CC capabilities. We plan or have in\-flight these capabilities. They include integrating Salesforce enhancements, implementing Presence Bi\-Sync, developing omnichannel, creating QM\+/quality, conducting sentiment analysis, and designing automation/self\-service patterns. Examples of automation/self\-service patterns are password reset self\-service IVR flows and Origins integration.
* Compliance, risk, and data\-flow architecture: Own the technical inputs required to satisfy multi‑region risk/compliance needs, including DPIA/LIA/ROPA/TPRA patterns, country data residency constraints, and risk items affecting schedule/solution design. Drive "secure by design" call recording and processing architectures.
* Carrier/SBC and routing design leadership involves leading carrier/provider architecture decisions. It also includes solution designs, considering constraints that require Teams and NICE migrations to occur together in certain routing models. Additionally, it requires finalizing EMEA routing designs.
* Operational reliability and ITSM guardrails: Define architecture standards for availability, survivability, monitoring, and change rigor while modernization executes—balancing "run" stability with transformation delivery.
* Executive\-ready architecture artifacts: Produce reference architecture, option papers, sequencing plans, and risk statements to support business cases, funding approvals, vendor due diligence, and leadership decision forums.


**Qualifications**
* 10–15\+ years developing enterprise telephony/voice and contact center solutions in several environments (global/multi‑region preferred).
* Demonstrated experience modernizing from legacy PBX/contact center platforms to cloud SaaS models with emphasis on routing/porting/numbering, agent workflows, and service continuity.
* You have Contact center domain depth (e.g., NICE\-like platforms) including call flows, IVR/ACD, recording, QA, analytics, and CRM integration patterns.
* You have good partner communication—able to translate architecture tradeoffs into clear decisions for all kinds of audiences.
* You have operational governance and discipline; comfortable operating in environments with active risk, compliance review cycles, and change controls.


**Additional Information**
 Our uniqueness is that we truly celebrate yours. Experian's culture and people are important differentiators. We take our people agenda very seriously and focus on what truly matters; DEI, work/life balance, development, authenticity, engagement, collaboration, wellness, reward \& recognition, volunteering... the list goes on. Experian's strong people first approach is award winning; Great Place To Work™ in 24 countries, FORTUNE Best Companies to work and Glassdoor Best Places to Work (globally 4\.4 Stars) to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or our Careers Site to understand why.
   

  

 Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. Innovation is a critical part of Experian's DNA and practices, and our diverse workforce drives our success. Everyone can succeed at Experian and bring their whole self to work, irrespective of their gender, ethnicity, religion, color, sexuality, physical ability or age. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.
   

  

**Recruitment Fraud Awareness** 
 \- Experian's recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @experian.com email address. Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Experian care for employee's work life balance, health, safety and wellbeing. In support of this endeavor, we offer best\-in\-class family well\-being benefits, enhanced medical benefits and paid time off.
