 Deccan AI builds the data, evaluation, and agentic infrastructure that helps frontier labs and enterprises ship AI that actually works in production. Our Helix and EnterpriseOS platforms put humans and AI side by side to catch failures, close evaluation gaps, and run mission\-critical workflows. As we move from data and evals into full\-scale enterprise deployments, we're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer / Solutions Architect to sit at the center of that motion: embedded with customers, owning the technical relationship, and turning ambiguous problems into shipped, reliable AI systems.
 



  





 This is a customer\-facing, build\-heavy role. You will spend as much time in a client's codebase and infrastructure as you do in a whiteboard session with their VP of Engineering. You are equally comfortable designing an architecture and writing the code that proves it out.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Embed directly with enterprise customers to scope, design, and build production AI solutions on top of Deccan AI's Helix and EnterpriseOS platforms.
* Own the end\-to\-end technical relationship for key accounts: requirements gathering, solution architecture, implementation, deployment, and post\-launch iteration.
* Translate ambiguous, often messy customer workflows into concrete technical designs data pipelines, agent architectures, evaluation harnesses, and integration points with the customer's existing infra.
* Write production\-grade code alongside customer engineering teams; this is not a slideware role.
* Build reusable patterns, tooling, and accelerators from each engagement so the next deployment moves faster than the last.
* Act as the technical voice of the customer internally feeding field learnings back into product and platform roadmaps.
* Debug and resolve issues in live, high\-stakes deployments, often under time pressure and with imperfect information.
* Present architecture, tradeoffs, and rollout plans to both engineering counterparts and executive stakeholders.



**What we're looking for** 



* 4\+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, or a forward\-deployed / professional\-services engineering role, ideally with exposure to AI, ML, or data\-intensive systems.
* Strong hands\-on coding ability (Python and/or a modern backend language) you can prototype, productionize, and debug your own work, not just review someone else's.
* Experience designing and deploying systems on at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including data pipelines and API\-level integrations.
* Working knowledge of LLM\-based systems: prompting, evaluation, RAG, agentic workflows, or fine\-tuning you don't need to have built a foundation model, but you need to have shipped something that uses one.
* Excellent communication skills you can move fluidly between a technical deep\-dive with engineers and a business conversation with a customer sponsor.
* A bias toward ownership: comfortable being the one person accountable for a customer's technical outcome, without a large team behind you at every step.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed and to work occasionally across customer time zones.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Prior experience in a forward\-deployed engineering, solutions engineering, or technical consulting role at an AI/ML or enterprise software company.
* Experience building or operating evaluation systems for AI agents or LLM applications.
* Familiarity with human\-in\-the\-loop workflows and production monitoring for AI systems.
* Startup experience, particularly in a 0\-to\-1 or early\-scale environment.



  





**Why Deccan AI** 



* Work at the point where AI research meets real enterprise deployment your work ships to production, not to a slide.
* High\-trust, high\-ownership culture: capable people who move fast and hold a high bar.
* Direct exposure to frontier AI labs and enterprise customers solving genuinely hard problems.
* Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and a seat at the table as the company scales.

**About WCT:** 




 WaferWire Technology Solutions (WCT) specializes in delivering comprehensive Cloud, Data and AI solutions through Microsoft's technology stack. Our services include Strategic Consulting, Data/AI Estate Modernization, and Cloud Adoption Strategy. We excel in Solution Design encompassing Application, Data, and AI Modernization, as well as Infrastructure Planning and Migrations. We focus on Implementation and Deployment of modern applications, continuous Performance Optimization, and future\-ready innovations in AI, ML, and security enhancements.  We are looking for a customer\-focused Presales Solution Consultant with strong expertise in Microsoft Azure, Data \& AI, Cloud Modernization, and the Microsoft Partner Ecosystem. **Responsibilities:** 



* **Solution Consulting \& Architecture**

* Ability to engage confidently with both business and technical stakeholders.
* Strong presentation, documentation, and communication skills.

* Azure Infrastructure \& Migration

title: Interior Design Consultant
description:
WE’RE HIRING Interior Design Consultant
 



 Studio Scintilla \| Powered by Craftsville
 



 📍 Gachibowli, Hyderabad \| Full\-time \| On\-site
 



  





 Design. Consult. Convert.
 



 Studio Scintilla is an end\-to\-end interior design and execution studio, established in 2016 and powered by Craftsville, our own in\-house modular factory.
 



 With 150\+ homes delivered, we create bespoke residential interiors from modular kitchens and wardrobes to complete home transformations backed by our in\-house 3D design and execution capabilities.
 



 We’re looking for an Interior Design Consultant who can bring together design understanding, client relationship skills, and a strong sales mindset.
 



  





 YOUR ROLE
 



 You’ll be the face of Studio Scintilla for prospective clients taking them from their first conversation to a signed project.
 



 You’ll understand their lifestyle and requirements, translate their ideas into a clear design direction, present concepts and materials, discuss budgets, prepare proposals, negotiate, and close.
 



  





 WHAT YOU’LL OWN
 



 Client Consultation
 



 • Manage clients from first inquiry through the sales process
 



 • Understand lifestyle, requirements, preferences, and budgets
 



 • Develop clear design briefs and manage client communication
 



 • Build trust and confidently guide clients through decisions
 



 Design \& Presentations
 



 • Create compelling mood boards and client presentations
 



 • Present portfolios, executed projects, concepts, and material options
 



 • Tailor presentations to make each client's vision feel personal and tangible
 



 Sales \& Commercial
 



 • Own the sales cycle — follow\-up → consultation → proposal → negotiation → closing
 



 • Prepare accurate quotations and budget proposals
 



 • Handle objections around budget, design, and timelines
 



 • Work towards individual and team sales targets
 



 Collaboration
 



 • Work closely with design, 3D, catalogue, execution, sales, and marketing teams
 



 • Ensure client requirements and quotations are realistic and deliverable
 



 • Bring client feedback and market insights back to the team
 



  





 WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
 



 • Strong understanding of interior design, styles, materials, and residential interiors
 



 • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
 



 • Experience creating mood boards, presentations, or proposals
 



 • Understanding of quotations, budgeting, and project scope
 



 • Strong consultative selling, negotiation, and closing skills
 



 • Ability to qualify leads and manage follow\-ups/pipeline
 



 • Basic knowledge of Canva, PowerPoint, Keynote, or similar tools
 



 • Working knowledge of CRM or sales tracking tools
 



 • Understanding of the interior design/execution process
 



 • Comfortable with client meetings and site visits
 



 • Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and professional
 



  





 EXPERIENCE
 



 1–3 years of experience in:
 



 • Interior design sales / consulting
 



 • Real estate sales
 



 • Furniture / modular interiors
 



 • High\-ticket B2C sales
 



 A Bachelor's degree in Interior Design, Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred.
 



 Prior experience in interior design, modular furniture, or real estate is strongly preferred.
 



 Candidates from strong sales backgrounds with a genuine understanding of interiors are also encouraged to apply.
 



  





 WHY STUDIO SCINTILLA?
 



 150\+ homes delivered.
 



 In\-house 3D design.
 



 In\-house execution.
 



 Powered by Craftsville.
 



 Join a team where you’ll have real ownership, real client interaction, and a direct impact on revenue and the client experience without the outsourcing gaps between design and execution.
 



  





 READY TO JOIN US?
 


* 📩 To apply: Send your portfolio/resume to team@scintillainterio.in or DM us directly.

title: Industry Consultant-Insurance
description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As an Industry Consultant for Insurance, you will guide insurance organizations through modernization journeys by aligning business strategy with digital capabilities. This role involves leveraging industry acumen to drive business outcomes, with a focus on improving customer engagement and implementing data\-driven risk assessment models.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Aligning Business Strategies: Align business strategy with digital capabilities across underwriting, claims, and policy administration to drive modernization journeys.
* Driving Automation: Leverage industry acumen to drive automation and improve customer engagement.
* Implementing Risk Models: Implement data\-driven risk assessment models that foster resilience and competitive advantage.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Digital Capabilities Alignment: Exposure to aligning business strategy with digital capabilities across underwriting, claims, and policy administration to drive modernization journeys. This includes understanding of digital technologies and their application in insurance industry.
* Industry Acumen Application: Exposure to leveraging industry acumen to drive automation and improve customer engagement, with a focus on business outcomes.
* Data\-Driven Risk Assessment: Exposure to implementing data\-driven risk assessment models that foster resilience and competitive advantage, including understanding of data analysis and modeling techniques.
* Automation Implementation: Exposure to driving automation in insurance organizations, including process automation and workflow optimization.
* Business Strategy Development: Exposure to developing business strategies that align with digital capabilities and industry trends, with a focus on improving customer engagement and driving business outcomes.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Data Analysis Skills: Exposure to data analysis and modeling techniques to implement data\-driven risk assessment models.
* Process Automation: Knowledge of process automation and workflow optimization in insurance organizations.
* Digital Technologies: Understanding of digital technologies and their application in the insurance industry.

title: Field Account Manager
description:
The Sales Account Manager will be responsible for all sales results of mid\-size and large accounts in a defined territory and for developing strong customer relations according to the organizational strategy for the assigned customer base. An essential part of this role is the active use of our CRM system (SFDC) to manage sales activities and customer interactions effectively as this tool is the foundation of our sales framework and operational sales steering, and a key enabler for this role to achieve his/her targets as well as Sartorius targets.
   

  

 The Sales Account Manager will be responsible for all sales results of mid\-size and large accounts in a defined territory and for developing strong customer relations according to the organizational strategy for the assigned customer base. An essential part of this role is the active use of our CRM system (SFDC) to manage sales activities and customer interactions effectively as this tool is the foundation of our sales framework and operational sales steering, and a key enabler for this role to achieve his/her targets as well as Sartorius targets.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities \& Tasks**
* Promote the organization's products and services within an assigned geographic area, product range or key account to achieve sales and revenue targets
* Identify new business opportunities aligned with the organization's overall market and growth strategy
* Actively use SFDC to manage and document leads and opportunities, all customer interactions and sales activities ensuring that all customer and opportunity information is up\-to\-date and accurately entered in the CRM system
* Analyze SFDC data for assigned customers to identify trends, generate customer insights and track sales performance
* Actively drive newly launched innovative products and services into the marketplace and proactively follow up on the successful implementation of sales activity
* Assess and analyze customer needs, generate leads, respond to customer inquiries and suggest products and services as appropriate
* Develop and implement account plans and request and coordinate resources in line with the account plans
* Work closely with cross functional team to create higher market perception and successful strategies to gain business from an account
* Coordinate and participate in marketing activities in assigned territory
* Frequently assess the potential of each customer and plan to realize it into business
* Manage and build strong customer relationships for long term partnership


**Qualification \& Skills**
* Master degree in life sciences or engineering (higher level of education would be beneficial)
* Minimum 5\-8 years field sales experience, with preferable laboratory / process based experience in Life Science
* Hands\-on knowledge and proactive usage of SFDC and other CRM tools
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills
* Self\-motivated, energetic, results oriented, capacity to work independently with a strong sense of responsibility
* Good teamwork skills and proven ability to also work with cross\-functional teams
* Willingness and ability to travel frequently
* Proven software skills, e.g. Microsoft Office


**About Sartorius**
 Sartorius is part of the solution in the fight against cancer, dementia, and many other diseases. Our technologies help translate scientific discoveries into real\-world medicine faster, so that new therapeutics can reach patients worldwide.
   

  

 We look for ambitious team players and creative minds, who want to contribute to this goal and advance their careers in a dynamic global environment.
   

  

 Join our global team and become part of the solution. We are looking forward to receiving your application.
   

  

 www.sartorius.com/careers

title: Senior Consultant AIM
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
 Looking for Sr AIM Consultant to join Delivery Team in AVEVA , India.
   

  

 You will be involved in implementing projects in Information Management / Digital twin domain for customers.
   

  

 Senior AIM Consultant is responsible for working as part of a team that delivers and supports software implementations, which meet our customer’s requirements using AVEVA AIM (Asset Information Management) or any other similar software.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Configure projects in Information management / AIM
* Training of key users
* Customer Interaction to understand their business processes
* System integration to 3’rd party systems or other in\-house system
* Migration of legacy data


**Knowledge, Skills and Experience required:**
* Master’s / Bachelor’s degree either in Computer Sciences or Engineering
* A minimum of 10 years of experience in the implementation of information management solutions to plant operation (OO) and engineering design companies (EPC)
* Knowledge of O\&G Plant Engineering and Operations (Process, Maintenance, Safety etc.) Digital Twin covering complete life cycle of the plant.
* Experience in Conducting requirement gathering and design sessions
* Conduct User Acceptance test
* Business Analysis skills and project coordination/management
* Proven experience of AVEVA products, primarily in AVEVA NET (AIM) or similar technologies
* Demonstrates a sound background in several of the following: C\#, .NET framework, JavaScript, XML, PowerShell, SQL, SSRS/SSIS, MS Office tools.
* Working knowledge of CAD file formats such as PDMS/DGN/DWG/PDS/SmartPlant authoring Apps would be an advantage
* Be able to work with members of product development and sales managers to develop solution positioning and client support
* Good verbal and written communication skills in English. Demonstrates sound presentation skills, creates concise and clear documentation.
* Knowledge about basic Network, Windows Server, Cloud, DB, Oracle, SQL server etc.


**India Benefits include:**
 Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well\-being support
   

  

 It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/
   

  

**Hybrid working**
 We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on\-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office\-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.
   

  

**Hiring process**
 Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring\-process
   

  

**About AVEVA**
 AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting\-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.
   

  

 We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability\-report.aveva.com/
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/
   

  

 AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third\-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.
   

  

 AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify your recruiter. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case\-by\-case basis.

title: Upstream Field Application Scientist
description:
Work Your Magic with us!
   

  

 Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.
   

  

**Your Role**
 As part of the Customer Application (CA) team within Process Solutions, you are responsible for offerings under Process Materials and Cell Culture Franchise (e.g., cell culture media, cell lines, biopharma materials) and Single\-Use and Integrated Platform Solutions Franchise (e.g., upstream perfusion systems).
   

  

* Act as the technical expert for upstream process development and biomanufacturing, partnering with customer’s technical teams to deliver consultative guidance and hands\-on support.
* Design, execute, and validate process development, scale\-up and implementation studies with customers, aligned with best practices; translating customer needs into technical outcomes.
* Communicate findings clearing through reports, meetings, and training; build trusted customer relationships and support technical onboarding.


**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical expertise and thought leadership**
* Act as subject matter technical expert in commercial and technical discussions; drive best\-in\-class capabilities and thought leadership to enable desired outcomes and impact.
* Represent the company as subject matter technical expert and industrial events; delivery thought leadership activities
* Apply scientific knowledge, experimental designs and hands\-on process design to address complex customer needs and troubleshooting.
* Capture technical findings and contribute to case studies, references and innovation roadmaps.
* Maintain up\-to\-date technical collaterals, catalogs and point of views; track competitor activities and customer insights to influence portfolio positioning and strategy.
* Deliver training to customers and internal teams on upstream bioprocesses and our upstream innovative offerings.
* Develop and share customer\-facing materials to support sales enablement.


**Customer engagement and value realization**
* Engage customers on challenges, trends and activities around upstream bioprocesses.
* Provide technical consultative guidance, technical training and best practice recommendations to accelerate adoption and implementation
* Support, nurtures and helps to close sales opportunities


**Collaborations with internal stakeholders**
* Partner with upstream sales development experts and account managers for customer centric upstream buying journey.
* Coordinate with franchise, R\&D and other internal stakeholders to address customer needs and roadmap impacts.
* Serve as escalation point for technical issues during evaluation, adaptation, scale\-up and implementation; drive timely resolution and customer satisfaction.
* Propose internal and external process improvements (simplify and act with urgency) and contribute to technical programs and seminars
* Proactively identify and capture opportunities using sales effectiveness tools
* Support M Lab Collaboration Center activities


**Who You Are**
* B.S., M.S. or PhD in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, or a related science or engineering discipline
* 6\+ years’ experience in biopharmaceutical technical roles in upstream bioprocesses, in lab, pilot and/or manufacturing scale environments. Extensive years of proven experience and knowledge in upstream bioprocesses.
* Technical mastery in upstream bioprocesses; strong hands\-on upstream cell line, media and process development, scale\-up and implementation studies.
* Proven abilities to translate customer needs into technical outcomes; proficient in data analyses and design of experiments.
* Excellent written and oral communication; capable of delivering reports, presentations and training to diverse audiences including senior internal stakeholders and management.
* Commercially astute; understands market needs and trends, processes and how technical solutions map technical and business impact.
* Collaborative; effective team player, in a cross\-functional, multicultural matrix environment; strong stakeholder management.
* Fluent in English, and local language, where applicable


**What we offer:** 
 We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
   

  

 Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

title: Supplier Enablement Analyst
description:
**Overview**
 The R2P Supplier Enablement Sr Analyst role is responsible for driving end\-to\-end supplier enablement and digital transaction adoption across the enterprise within the Requisition\-to\-Pay (R2P) Operations \& Support organization. This role owns supplier onboarding, SAP Ariba Network enablement, enterprise licensing adoption, transaction readiness, and supplier success outcomes, ensuring suppliers can transact digitally through approved platforms in a timely, compliant, and sustainable manner. The role acts as both a project lead and trusted advisor to suppliers and internal stakeholders, leveraging techno\-functional expertise to accelerate adoption, resolve complex challenges, and maximize business value realization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Supplier Onboarding \& Transaction Enablement
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end supplier onboarding and enablement activities, including registration, account strategy assessment, supplier segmentation, Enterprise Account enablement, catalog readiness, transaction configuration, and compliance validation to support digital commerce objectives. (Executes)
* Drive SAP Ariba Network enablement and enterprise licensing adoption, educating suppliers on platform capabilities, account structures, subscription options, transaction requirements, and best practices to maximize platform utilization and business value. (Executes)
* Manage supplier enablement engagements as structured projects with defined timelines, deliverables, success criteria, stakeholder communication plans, and adoption milestones. (Owns)
* Perform techno\-functional assessments of supplier capabilities and transaction readiness, identifying integration, configuration, process, and operational gaps that may impact electronic transaction adoption. (Executes)
* Partner with suppliers, SAP Ariba support teams, integration teams, and internal stakeholders to resolve onboarding, connectivity, invoicing, catalog, purchase order, and transaction processing challenges. (Executes)
* Ensure supplier enablement activities adhere to enterprise compliance, risk management, master data governance, security, and system control requirements, escalating exceptions and risks as necessary. (Owns)


 Supplier Support \& Issue Resolution
   

  

* Act as the primary point of accountability for supplier enablement success, monitoring supplier progress from onboarding through steady\-state adoption and transaction compliance. (Owns)
* Establish and track supplier adoption metrics including transaction volume, invoice compliance, electronic invoicing utilization, catalog adoption, PO automation rates, and overall network engagement. (Executes)
* Proactively identify adoption barriers, transaction failures, process inefficiencies, and supplier experience challenges, implementing corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives. (Owns)
* Engage directly with supplier leadership and operational teams to drive issue resolution, adoption acceleration, and long\-term supplier success. (Executes)
* Manage escalations involving complex business, operational, integration, configuration, or system\-related issues, coordinating resolution across SAP Ariba, Procurement, Finance, IT, and Governance teams. (Leads)
* Provide consultation and guidance on SAP Ariba functionality, transaction troubleshooting, best practices, and process optimization opportunities. (Consulted)


 Documentation, Adoption \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Maintain supplier\-facing documentation, training materials, enablement playbooks, process guides, and knowledge repositories to support scalable global enablement efforts. (Owns)
* Analyze supplier enablement performance, transaction adoption trends, operational metrics, and recurring issues to identify root causes and drive sustainable improvements. (Executes)
* Create adoption dashboards, supplier success scorecards, project status reporting, and executive\-level insights to support governance and decision\-making. (Executes)
* Recommend process enhancements, automation opportunities, and platform optimization initiatives to improve supplier experience, operational efficiency, and compliance outcomes. (Consulted / Leads)
* Support enterprise supplier migration initiatives, digital transformation programs, and SAP Ariba capability expansion projects, ensuring successful supplier adoption and change management. (Executes)


 Collaboration \& Governance Alignment
   

  

* Partner with Category Management, Strategic Sourcing, Procurement Operations, Finance, IT, Master Data, Risk, Compliance, SAP Ariba, and Governance teams to develop and execute supplier enablement strategies aligned with enterprise objectives. (Consulted / Executes)
* Influence supplier and stakeholder decision\-making through data\-driven recommendations, adoption insights, and subject matter expertise in supplier enablement and SAP Ariba processes. (Executes)
* Participate in governance forums, operational reviews, supplier performance discussions, and transformation initiatives to ensure alignment with business priorities and digital procurement goals. (Consulted)
* Serve as a trusted advisor and escalation point for supplier enablement strategy, enterprise licensing adoption, supplier experience, and SAP Ariba operational excellence initiatives. (Owns)


**Qualifications**
* 9\-11 years of experience in supplier enablement or procurement operations, with exposure to downstream AP operations within a shared services or global delivery environment
* Hands\-on experience supporting supplier onboarding or transaction enablement in SAP environments
* Experience working in a global or multi\-regional operating model

**About Kinaxis**
 Elevate your career journey by embracing a new challenge with Kinaxis. We are experts in tech, but it’s really our people who give us passion to always seek ways to do things better. As such, we’re serious about your career growth and professional development, because People matter at Kinaxis.
   

  

 In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers based in Ottawa, Canada. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, and support 40,000\+ users in over 100 countries. As a global leader in end\-to\-end supply chain management, we enable supply chain excellence for all industries. We are expanding our team in Chennai and around the world as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
   

  

 Our journey in India began in 2020 and we have been growing steadily since then! Building a high\-trust and high\-performance culture is important to us and we are proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified TM . Our state\-of\-the\-art office, located in the World Trade Centre in Chennai, offers our growing team space for expansion and collaboration.
   

  

**Location**
 Chennai, India
   

  

**About The Team**
 As a member of our Consulting Team, you understand our customers’ most pressing business performance challenges and you are committed to helping our customers solve complex challenges in the distributed value chain that is prevalent in manufacturing today.
   

  

****What you will do****
* Participate in in the end\-to\-end deployment of production scheduling tool including deep\-dive customer business requirements discovery sessions and develop requirements specifications documentation.
* Collaborates closely with agile team members to support the configuration, implementation of Maestro software to enable the solution according to our customers distinct needs
* Translate business requirements into Kinaxis Maestro software specifications, following supply chain industry trends and best practices.
* Support senior team members in providing creative solutions to complex business problems while maintaining best practices.
* Participate in data management and data integration activities, including source systems data transformation, data loading, data cleanup and validation.
* Perform training of customer end users on the configured solution.
* Provide technical support to end users and resolve issues of the configured solutions, escalating to senior team members as needed.
* Support the validation and testing of the solution and capture user feedback.
* Actively engage, guide and mentor to develop the skills of junior consultants on projects.
* Any other reasonable project related tasks as assigned by the Project Manager.


****What we are looking for****
* Candidates with results\-oriented mindset, focusing on improving client satisfaction and providing a very high standard of service, driving towards Kinaxis’s success.
* Sound knowledge in Supply Chain concepts especially scheduling with 6\+ years of experience.
* Strong intent to learn our first in class product “Maestro”
* Work in a fast\-paced project environment and co\-ordinate with members at all levels in an organization
* Highly adaptable professional, able to embrace teamwork in diverse and evolving work environments.
* Capability to lead by example, having the drive to think in an innovative way and have passion about new challenges
* Ability to solve complex problems, think critically and make sound judgement decisions.
* A passion for working in customer facing roles that require high level of interpersonal, communication, facilitation and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively in English, both verbally and in writing
* Technical skills such as SQL, R, Java Script, Python, etc.
* Experience with manufacturing planning solutions such as Kinaxis, SAP, JDA, etc. is an added advantage


 \#Senior
   

  

**Work With Impact:** 
 Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day—when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
   

  

**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:** 
 Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Ford, Unilever, Yamaha, P\&G, Lockheed\-Martin, and more.
   

  

**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:** 
 Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) \- Healthcare MarTech** 




 The Forward Deployed Engineer is a business\-facing, hands\-on product and engineering role. The FDE works directly with healthcare marketing stakeholders to understand operational needs, shape practical solutions and create working evidence quickly.
 



 The role combines healthcare marketing knowledge, product and solution design, agentic engineering and enterprise technology leadership. The FDE partners with architecture, data, Adobe, security and delivery teams to move validated prototypes toward safe, scalable production use.
 



 Primary Responsibilities:
 



 · Healthcare Marketing Partnership
 



 o Work directly with marketing and marketing\-operations stakeholders to understand goals, current workflows, delays and decision points.
 



 o Apply healthcare payer, member and consumer context to campaign, audience, journey, offer, content and measurement decisions.
 



 o Account for privacy, consent, communication preferences, contact policies, approvals and human accountability.
 



 · Product \& Solution Design
 



 o Convert ambiguous business needs into a clear user problem, measurable outcome, constraints and priorities.
 



 o Design the customer journey, process, roles, handoffs, decisions, system touchpoints and feedback loop together.
 



 o Compare native platform capability, deterministic automation, agentic components and custom services using value, risk, cost and scale.
 



 o Build thin working prototypes, test with users and recommend whether to scale, change or stop.
 



 · Agentic Solution Engineering
 



 o Use ChatGPT or Claude effectively for discovery, analysis, design, coding, debugging, testing and correction \- not only content generation.
 



 o Build working agentic solutions using an API or SDK, structured outputs and at least one tool or enterprise interface.
 



 o Apply appropriate patterns for context, retrieval, function calling, MCP\-style integration, state, memory and error handling.
 



 o Define evaluation, guardrails, human approval, traceability, fallback, monitoring, latency and usage\-cost controls.
 



 · Enterprise Engineering \& Scale
 



 o Develop and review working software in a modern language such as Python, TypeScript, Java or C\#.
 



 o Design APIs, authentication, schemas, data pipelines, batch and event\-driven integrations with clear data\-quality controls.
 



 o Address identity, security, reliability, performance, scalability, cost, supportability and operational ownership.
 



 o Guide deployment, DevSecOps, observability, support and prototype\-to\-production decisions.
 



 · Collaboration \& Knowledge Transfer
 



 o Facilitate design reviews, communicate trade\-offs and influence business and technical ways of working.
 



 o Mentor engineers and work effectively with enterprise architects and platform specialists without replacing their accountabilities.
 



 o Document solution components, decisions, integrations, controls and the production transition path.
 



**Success Measures:** 




 · Shorter time from business need to validated solution evidence, measured against an agreed baseline.
 



 · Working prototypes meet defined functional, quality, safety and user\-acceptance criteria.
 



 · Solutions have a clear production path, operational ownership, controlled usage cost and stakeholder adoption.
 



**Required Qualifications:** 




 · Demonstrated healthcare payer, member or consumer marketing experience, including campaign lifecycle, audiences, journeys, communication controls and measurement.
 



 · Experience partnering directly with business stakeholders, framing ambiguous problems and shaping journey, process, operating\-model and solution trade\-offs.
 



 · Evidence of rapid prototyping, user testing and outcome\-based roadmap decisions.
 



 · Proficient use of ChatGPT or Claude as a builder, with clear methods for context management, verification and correction.
 



 · Hands\-on experience coding an agentic solution using tools or APIs, retrieval, function calling, MCP\-style integration, state and error handling.
 



 · Understanding of evaluation, guardrails, human control, monitoring, fallback and AgentOps practices.
 



 · Hands\-on software\-development and integration experience across APIs, data, events or batch patterns.
 



 · Ability to understand enterprise architecture and non\-functional requirements, mentor engineers and influence production\-scale design in a client\-facing environment.
 



**Preferred Qualifications:** 




 · Adobe MarTech solution literacy across AEP/RTCDP, AJO, CJA, audiences, journeys, publishing and activation channels.
 



 · Relevant certification, structured learning or portfolio evidence, plus deeper experience in Medicare, benefits, claims, retirement, offer management or regulated member communications.

title: BC Sector-Life Sciences-ED
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
 The GDS Forecasting COE Leader is a senior leadership role accountable for building, scaling, and running a Center of Excellence dedicated to commercial forecasting services for Life Sciences clients. The role sits at the intersection of consulting go\-to\-market growth, delivery, analytics capability\-building, and commercial performance. It owns the COE talent and methodology backbone and positions forecasting as a differentiated offering within the broader Life Sciences practice. Reporting to the Life Sciences GDS Leader, the role is the primary escalation point for client delivery quality and internal capability development.
   

  

**Essential Functions Of The Job**
**Go\-to\-Market**
* Partner with solution, account, and sector leaders to identify, shape, and pursue forecasting\-led opportunities across existing and prospective client accounts.
* Lead or co\-lead proposal development, including solution design, pricing strategy, and staffing plans for forecasting engagements and RFPs.
* Build reusable forecasting assets including accelerators, frameworks, demo models, and points of view to reduce proposal cycle time and improve win rates.
* Represent the COE in client pitches, oral presentations, and executive discussions.
* Track and report the COE sales pipeline, win/loss trends, revenue contribution, and forecast to Life Sciences leadership.
* Develop and publish thought leadership, benchmarking studies, and conference content to establish market credibility.
* Identify and evaluate strategic alliances with forecasting technology and data partners to strengthen the solution stack.


**Delivery**
* Own the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of forecasting deliverables across COE\-supported engagements.
* Lead engagements spanning customized platform or solution development and forecasting managed services.
* Establish and enforce model validation, assumption documentation, MAPE/accuracy tracking, peer review, and audit\-readiness standards.
* Define and continuously refine forecasting methodologies, matching the approach to the business question and available data.
* Provide technical oversight over gross\-to\-net modeling, loss\-ofexclusivity impact, TRx/NBRx trends, market sizing, competitive dynamics, and related parameters.
* Manage engagement economics, including utilization, effort estimates, and margin performance.
* Build and mentor a multi\-tiered team from analysts through senior managers, balancing pharmaceutical commercial expertise and analytics capability.
* Institutionalize lessons learned, client feedback, and forecast\-accuracy post\-mortems into refreshed playbooks and training.
* Guide adoption of forecasting platforms and tools, including AI\-first and agentic forecasting architectures where relevant.
* Act as the escalation point for at\-risk engagements and resolve delivery, staffing, or client relationship issues.


**Analytical/Decision Making** 
**Responsibilities**
* Determine the appropriate forecasting methodology, model architecture, data sources, validation approach, and governance level for complex client needs.
* Prioritize investments across talent, assets, platforms, alliances, and adjacent capabilities based on pipeline, scalability, and expected value.
* Balance growth, quality, utilization, margin, and talent sustainability across the COE portfolio.
* Make senior interventions on at\-risk engagements and decide when models, assumptions, staffing, or delivery plans require correction.
* Translate quantitative model outputs and uncertainty into clear commercial decisions and executive narratives.


**Education \& Experience**
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Business, Statistics, Economics, Life Sciences, or a related field from a reputed institution; an advanced quantitative degree is a plus.
* 14\+ years of overall experience, including at least 8\-10 years in pharmaceutical or Life Sciences commercial forecasting.
* Experience in a top\-tier consulting firm, pharmaceutical commercial analytics function, or specialized forecasting firm is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience building or scaling a COE, practice area, or specialized delivery team, including P\&L or revenue accountability.
* Proven client\-facing delivery leadership across complex, multi\-market forecasting engagements.
* Experience managing large, distributed teams across onshore\-offshore delivery models.


**Knowledge And Skills Requirements**
* Deep expertise in pharmaceutical commercial forecasting, including MAPE, gross\-to\-net, loss of exclusivity, TRx/NBRx, market share dynamics, and epidemiology\- and analogue\-based methods.
* Strong familiarity with pharmaceutical data platforms and datasets, including IQVIA, Komodo Health, Symphony Health, claims, and EHR data.
* Proficiency in Excel modeling, R, Python, and forecasting\-specific platforms; familiarity with AI/ML forecasting and agentic AI applications is highly desirable.
* Strong business development capability across proposal writing, client pitching, pricing, and senior relationship management.
* Proven people leadership across team building, performance management, mentoring, and capability development.
* Executive presence and the ability to translate complex quantitative outputs into clear business narratives.
* Understanding of the broader Life Sciences commercial ecosystem, including market access, patient engagement, and competitive intelligence.
* Strong governance and risk orientation, with attention to model accuracy, documentation rigor, and audit readiness.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior – School Partnerships
description:
Senior – School Partnerships
 



  





 Company: Dreamtime Learning
 



 Location: Hyderabad, India \| Travel across India as required
 



 Experience: 5\+ years in the K\-12 / School Education ecosystem
 



 Working Days: Monday–Saturday
 



 Laptop: Mandatory
 



  





 About the Role
 



  





 We are looking for a Senior – School Partnerships professional who understands the Indian school ecosystem and can build trusted relationships with school owners, trustees, principals, academic heads and education leaders.
 



  





 This is a consultative business development and sales role. The successful candidate will combine education expertise, relationship\-building, storytelling and commercial ability to engage schools, understand their needs and create opportunities for meaningful AI\-led transformation.
 



  





 We are looking for people who can tell a compelling story, influence senior stakeholders and convert conversations into partnerships.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Build School Partnerships
 



  





 \* Build and maintain strong relationships with school owners, trustees, principals and academic leaders.
 



 \* Develop a high\-quality network of schools across India.
 



 \* Identify and qualify new institutional opportunities.
 



 \* Build relationships from initial introduction through engagement, negotiation and closure.
 



 \* Develop long\-term partnerships with schools and education institutions.
 



  





 Consultative Sales \& Business Development
 



  





 \* Understand the academic, operational and strategic challenges faced by schools.
 



 \* Identify opportunities where Dreamtime Learning can create meaningful value.
 



 \* Lead discovery conversations, presentations, workshops and demonstrations.
 



 \* Convert school challenges into compelling business and education propositions.
 



 \* Manage the sales cycle from prospecting → discovery → presentation → proposal → negotiation → closure.
 



 \* Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
 



 \* Achieve agreed monthly and quarterly business development and revenue targets.
 



  





 Storytelling \& Stakeholder Engagement
 



  





 \* Present ideas around the future of education, AI and school transformation in a simple, compelling and relatable way.
 



 \* Be an engaging storyteller who can make senior education stakeholders understand why change is necessary and what is possible.
 



 \* Adapt communication to different audiences, from teachers and academic heads to principals, trustees and school owners.
 



 \* Conduct engaging workshops and leadership conversations.
 



 \* Represent Dreamtime Learning at principal forums, Sahodaya circles, education conclaves, conferences and industry events.
 



  





 Market Development
 



  





 \* Generate new opportunities through networking, referrals, events and existing relationships.
 



 \* Expand the school’s institutional network across assigned territories.
 



 \* Develop relationships with education communities, associations and influential stakeholders.
 



 \* Track market trends, competitor activity and changing school priorities.
 



 \* Identify new markets and partnership opportunities.
 



  





 Voice of the School
 



  





 \* Understand the real needs and challenges of schools.
 



 \* Capture market feedback and share insights with Academic, Product, Marketing and Leadership teams.
 



 \* Help shape how Dreamtime Learning communicates its value to schools.
 



 \* Identify emerging needs that can influence future offerings and engagement strategies.
 



  





 Key Result Indicators (KRIs)
 



  





 Performance will be measured across commercial growth, relationship development and school engagement.
 



  





 Commercial KRIs
 



  





 \* Achievement of monthly and quarterly revenue / business targets.
 



 \* Number and value of qualified opportunities generated.
 



 \* Sales pipeline development and pipeline coverage.
 



 \* Number of school meetings and qualified stakeholder conversations.
 



 \* Presentation and demonstration\-to\-opportunity conversion.
 



 \* Proposal\-to\-closure conversion rate.
 



 \* Number of new institutional partnerships closed.
 



 \* Revenue generated from new and existing partnerships.
 



  





 Relationship KRIs
 



  





 \* Growth and quality of the school network.
 



 \* Number of senior\-level relationships established.
 



 \* Engagement with school owners, trustees, principals and academic heads.
 



 \* Referrals and opportunities generated through existing relationships.
 



 \* Participation and engagement in key education forums and networks.
 



  





 Engagement \& Adoption KRIs
 



  





 \* Workshops and school leadership sessions conducted.
 



 \* Quality of stakeholder engagement.
 



 \* Successful transition of partnerships from sales to implementation.
 



 \* Expansion opportunities within existing school relationships.
 



 \* Partner satisfaction and relationship health.
 



  





 What We’re Looking For
 



  





 We are looking for someone who combines education credibility, storytelling ability and commercial drive.
 



  





 Essential
 



  





 \* 5\+ years of experience in the K\-12 ecosystem — EdTech, publishing, curriculum, school leadership, education services, technology or related sectors.
 



 \* Strong understanding of the Indian school ecosystem.
 



 \* Existing relationships with school owners, principals, trustees or academic leaders will be highly valued.
 



 \* Excellent communication, presentation and storytelling skills.
 



 \* Strong consultative selling and business development capability.
 



 \* Confidence engaging senior stakeholders.
 



 \* Ability to understand needs, influence decisions and close opportunities.
 



 \* Good understanding of pedagogy, curriculum, school operations and technology adoption.
 



 \* Willingness to travel extensively across India.
 



 \* Strong digital awareness and willingness to learn about AI and emerging technologies.
 



 \* Laptop mandatory.
 



  





 The Person We Are Looking For
 



  





 You could be an education professional, curriculum leader, EdTech professional, school solutions specialist, consultant, institutional sales professional or school leader.
 



  





 More importantly, you are:
 



  





 A Storyteller
 



 You can take an idea and make people see its possibility.
 



  





 A Relationship Builder
 



 People trust you and are willing to open doors for you.
 



  





 A Consultative Seller
 



 You listen first, understand the problem and then create the right proposition.
 



  





 A Commercial Thinker
 



 You understand that relationships must ultimately translate into opportunities, partnerships and revenue.
 



  





 An Education Insider
 



 You understand how schools operate, how decisions are made and what matters to education leaders.
 



  





 An AI \& Innovation Enthusiast
 



 You are curious about how AI and emerging technologies can reshape education and can communicate these possibilities to non\-technical audiences.
 



  





 What Success Looks Like
 



  





 The successful person will become a trusted education advisor and a strong commercial representative of Dreamtime Learning — someone who can open doors, create meaningful conversations, build conviction, and ultimately turn those relationships into successful school partnerships.
 



  





 If you can build the relationship, tell the story, create the opportunity and close the partnership — we want to hear from you.
